title: Mizan EvalSet pack manifest
description: FORMAT-ONLY structural schema for a pack EvalSet file (design §3.4a, D6). P2 carries + validates the EvalSet manifest; it is NOT imported into the registry store or run (that is the separate eval-set capability). Structural validation covers only the required metadata/spec.members core. The reserved-but-not-interpreted optional objects (spec.inputs, per-member bind/weight/required, aggregation/display incl. a folded threshold) are ALLOWED and validation-lenient — do not tighten additionalProperties so far that it rejects them. A pass/fail threshold is folded under aggregation/display; it is NOT a new top-level spec field (spec is additionalProperties:false so a stray top-level threshold is rejected).

inputs.description: RESERVED set-level input alias map (design §3.4a). Carried, schema-allowed, not interpreted in P2.

bind.description: RESERVED per-member placeholder binding (design §3.4a). Carried, not interpreted in P2.

aggregation.description: RESERVED aggregation config carried for the future runner (design §3.4a). method is validated against the reserved enum when present; threshold and other keys are lenient.

gate.description: Opt-in pass/fail gate flag (default false). Consumed by the eval-set runner; carried and lenient here.

display.description: RESERVED display config carried for the future runner (design §3.4a). Lenient.
